title: ACE: Quality of Life — Combat Automation Engine
description: Comprehensive D&D 5e combat automation. Supports both 2014 and 2024 rules with automatic edition detection. Attack resolution, damage separation by type, save automation, target state assessment, concentration tracking, and extended Active Effects — one module, no dependency chain. New worlds start on the Conservative preset; four presets and per-setting control are in the config panel.

recommends.reason: Lets ACE's core-function patches (concentration on damage + spell/pact damage) coexist safely with other modules that touch the same functions. ACE works fully without it — it falls back to a direct patch — but installing lib-wrapper is recommended for maximum module compatibility.
